sources.note: For Ama (sister branch of Nimo-Nakwi within Left May; nothing on Nakwi): one non-contrastive stress per phonological word on the heaviest syllable by a vowel-quality hierarchy (/ai au/ heaviest.. /Å/ lightest), with stress-attracting 'heavy' suffixes, a pre-stressing suffix -tÅnÅ, a last-occurrence tendency when all vowels are alike, and a few lexical exceptions; stress = loudness + length. Phonemic word tone (rising vs rising-falling) on the last stressed syllable of 1-2 syllable words; four contrastive intonation patterns.
